QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates looked-and-found-nothing, did-not-look-in-that-layer, and never-read, but it never names a "definitive for a reason that is not absence" grade. It does not say an empty reply can be definitive because of something other than absence, such as a refusal or an invalid query. The three-way split it gives is a different one.
